desc: Bringing the quality of GLx optics to mini reflex sights, the RS-15 is the next-generation pistol optic packed with features. This mini reflex sight features a larger window, 7075 aluminum construction, and includes a mounting plate for GLOCK MOS with out-of-the-box compatibility with a wide variety of pistol slides. Side-mounted brightness buttons make it easy to use, and the top-mounted battery compartment lets you quickly change batteries without removing your optic. This model comes with a Red Dot Bright ACSS Vulcan Dot reticle, which features a precise dot with an outer circle that extends beyond the visible lens. This outer circle provides a quick reference for your dot, helping you adjust and get your reticle on target.
